tool.name: hebrew_translator
tool.description: Translates Hebrew prompts to English and requests responses in a specific language. Use this tool when you receive Hebrew text that needs to be processed by an LLM. This saves tokens by translating to English (which uses fewer tokens) while still getting responses in the user's preferred language.

prompt.description: The Hebrew text to translate and process

reply_in_english.description: If true, requests the LLM to reply in English. If false (default), requests reply in Hebrew. Use true to save additional tokens on the response.

force_rtl.description: If true, requests RTL formatting for Hebrew output. Incompatible with reply_in_english.

force_translate.description: If true, forces translation even if text is not detected as Hebrew
